title: GRID-Planner: Graph-Structured Relational Reward Shaping for Diffusion Planning
title_zh: GRID-Planner：用于扩散规划的图结构关系奖励塑造

paragraphs.en: GRID-Planner是一个结合图结构与奖励的扩散规划框架，旨在提升自动驾驶规划的安全性和舒适性。 Autonomous driving planning requires selecting trajectories that remain safe, rule-compliant, and comfortable under complex multi-agent interactions, yet robust closed-loop decision making in planning-critical scenes remains challenging. Existing diffusion- and RL-based planners often rely on generic rewards and use relational structure mainly for representation, limiting how planning-critical rollouts shape policy improvement. We present GRID-Planner, a graph--reward integrated diffusion planning framework that aligns generative planning with structured relational signals. Specifically, GRID-Planner combines graph-aware importance weighting, a time-indexed relational reward surrogate, and an advantage-weighted diffusion objective with on-policy self-distillation, forming a rollout-return-advantage-update loop without explicit likelihoods. Experiments on nuPlan and interPlan show that, compared with the diffusion-only baseline, GRID-Planner reduces collision rate, lane deviation, and jerk by 35.8\%, 60.8\%, and 27.4\%, respectively, and improves the planning score by 3.4\%. Project website: https://github.com/yangzhaojason/GRID-Planner.
paragraphs.zh: GRID-Planner是一个结合图结构与奖励的扩散规划框架，旨在提升自动驾驶规划的安全性和舒适性。自动驾驶规划需要在复杂的多智能体交互下选择安全、合规且舒适的轨迹，然而在规划关键场景中实现稳健的闭环决策仍然具有挑战性。 现有的基于扩散模型和强化学习的规划器通常依赖通用奖励，并且主要将关系结构用于表征，限制了规划关键的 rollout 对策略改进的塑造作用。 我们提出 GRID-Planner，一个图-奖励一体化融合的扩散规划框架，将生成式规划与结构化关系信号对齐。 具体而言，GRID-Planner 结合了图感知重要性加权、时间索引的关系奖励代理，以及带有在线策略自蒸馏的优势加权扩散目标，构成了一个无需显式似然的 rollout-回报-优势-更新循环。 在 nuPlan 和 interPlan 上的实验表明，与仅用扩散模型的基线相比，GRID-Planner 将碰撞率、车道偏离和急动度分别降低了 35.8\%、60.8\% 和 27.4\%，并将规划得分提升了 3.4\%。 项目网站：https://github.com/yangzhaojason/GRID-Planner。
